environment.description: Celery worker deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with standard HTTPS listener (TLS termination at ALB, no client certificate requirement). The webhook endpoint /api/v1/webhooks is publicly accessible. Log output written to CloudWatch Logs via awslogs driver. No input sanitization middleware on the ALB or in the Flask layer beyond what's in the code. Any HTTP client can POST to the webhook endpoint.

config.alb_listener: HTTPS:443 with ACM certificate, no mutual TLS
